title: Open and closed restrictions detect ordinary module isomorphisms
statement: Fix ell,E [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let S,U,Z be qcqs schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], j:U→S a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and i:Z→S a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], with disjoint images whose union is S. For every morphism f:M→N of modules over the completed integral coefficient sheaf on S [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], if both ordinaryPull(j).map(f) and ordinaryPull(i).map(f) are isomorphisms then f is an isomorphism. The functors are exactly those of [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models]. Coefficient and site universes are independent; this statement involves only module sheaves, no derived category or ambient immersion.

source.place: Tags 09AH, lemma-ses-associated-to-open; 09AG, lemma-jshriek-zero; 09BM, lemma-closed-immersion-complement-retrocompact-exact. Apply the natural module localization sequence and the short five lemma.

proof.text: Use the invertibility of the actual ordinary coefficient map for the open immersion. Compare ring left adjoints with localized restriction using their unit equation. The continuous map-pullback site adjunction gives an adjunction on modules. Construct the slice module equivalence by Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence, retaining the equality of its functor with actual module pushforward; pushforwardComp compares its composition with slice restriction without unfolding a full functor equality. Uniqueness of module left adjoints yields ordinaryOpenSliceComparison, with independent site and coefficient universes.

Apply the independent-universe completed localization sequence to M and N. Naturality of the extension counit and the closed unit supplies a morphism of short exact sequences with middle component f. The open comparison makes the first vertical map invertible; the hypothesis on closed pullback makes the last vertical map invertible. Mathlib ShortComplex.isIso₂_of_shortExact_of_isIso₁₃ gives IsIso f. Empty pieces are included.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AH and 09AG: actual independent-universe localized module sequence, adjunction-compatible open comparison, and Mathlib short five lemma. R8 writes both combination steps and the local covering/exactness arguments; only the closed specialization-unit step is split off.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryCompletedOpenClosedDetection
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (S U Z : Scheme.{t})
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U]
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (j : U ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hcover : Set.range j.base ∪ Set.range i.base = Set.univ)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (Set.range j.base) (Set.range i.base)) :
    ∀ {M N : Mod l E S none} (f : M ⟶ N),
      IsIso ((ordinaryPull l E j).map f) →
      IsIso ((ordinaryPull l E i).map f) → IsIso f
